input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone. It’s been happening for the past few hours, and I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.
I just checked, and my messaging app is currently unable to send MMS messages. What should I try next?

It looks like my phone is currently in Airplane Mode, so I’m not able to make regular calls or use mobile data right now. I haven’t seen any specific error messages when trying to send an MMS—just that it won’t go through. 

Should I turn off Airplane Mode and try again?
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode, but I still can’t send MMS messages. Is there something else I should check or try?

Here’s what I see at the top of my screen:
- There are signal bars, but it says “2G” and the signal is poor.
- There’s an icon that looks like mobile data is disabled.
- Since mobile data is disabled, I’m not able to browse the internet with Wi-Fi turned off.

Would you like me to try enabling mobile data now?
I’ve enabled mobile data and switched my network mode to 5G, and now I have an excellent signal. However, I still can’t send MMS messages. Is there something else I should try?
I checked my APN settings, and the MMSC URL is set to: http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc. Is this correct, or should I update anything here?
I’m not entirely sure how to reset my APN settings and reboot my device. Could you please provide step-by-step instructions? That would be really helpful!

I followed your instructions to reset the APN settings and rebooted my device, but unfortunately, I still can’t send MMS messages. Is there anything else I should try? I’m starting to get a bit frustrated that it’s still not working.

I checked, and Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned off on my device. I haven’t had any issues sending regular SMS messages—they go through just fine. I also haven’t installed or updated any apps recently that might affect messaging.

What should I try next?
I checked the permissions for my messaging app, and it currently has permission for SMS and phone, but not for storage. Should I grant storage permission to the app and try sending an MMS again?
I granted storage permission to my messaging app and tried sending an MMS again, but it still isn’t working. Is there anything else I can try?
